title: Bicycle Rush Hour Utrecht (Netherlands)
summary: A sped-up two-minute view of morning rush hour at a busy Utrecht junction, where thousands of bicycles and buses pass each day. It illustrates a city where about a third of trips are by bike.
why: HN links it as a vivid example of what bike-centred cities look like in debates on cars, helmets and urban design.

quote.text: Here is a nice example of a typical rush hour
